skill.name: aws-secrets-rotation
skill.description: Plan and implement AWS Secrets Manager rotation for databases, API keys, SSH keys, and custom credentials.
skill.summary: Build AWS Secrets Manager rotation workflows with Lambda, monitoring, audits, and emergency rotation steps.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly an AWS Secrets Manager guide with legitimate examples for rotation, monitoring, and audits. Confirmed risks remain where examples read local SSH private keys, write private key files, print secret values, and understate the skill risk as safe. Most code-fence, documentation-link, and official provider API detections are false positives.

remediation.suggestion: Change the risk declaration from safe to an elevated level and warn users before any private-key or secret-value handling.
Use a generated placeholder key path and explain strict permissions, cleanup, and approval requirements before handling real private keys.

remediation.issue: Secret retrieval examples print values to stdout.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid commands that display secret values. Show safer retrieval patterns that keep values in memory or protected files only.

remediation.issue: Stripe key rotation revokes the old key immediately.
remediation.suggestion: Add staged rollout guidance, dependency validation, rollback steps, and delayed revocation for production integrations.

semantic_findings.title: Misleading Safe Risk Metadata
semantic_findings.description: The front matter declares risk: safe, but the skill includes examples that access SSH private keys and retrieve secret values. This can mislead users or automated installers about the sensitivity of the workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The risk label is explicit in the front matter and conflicts with the later private-key example. The issue is semantic because the scanner reports sensitive access but not the misleading safety claim.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive API Key Revocation Without Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The Stripe rotation example revokes the old key during finishSecret without showing rollback, propagation checks, or a staged disable period. Copying this flow can break production integrations if dependents still use the old key.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code clearly calls requests.delete for the old key after reading it from the current secret. The example has validation for the new key but no shown dependency readiness or rollback guard.

content.value_statement: Manual credential rotation is slow and error-prone for teams that manage AWS workloads. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Secrets Manager rotation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates AWS Secrets Manager examples for RDS credentials, API keys, SSH keys, and custom credentials.
Shows Lambda rotation logic for creating, setting, testing, and finishing rotated secrets.
Provides Stripe API key rotation examples with create, validate, revoke, and promote steps.
Includes CloudWatch alarm guidance for Secrets Manager rotation failures.
Provides shell and Python audit examples for rotation status and compliance reporting.
Covers emergency rotation prompts for compromised database and API credentials.
limitations: Examples need review before use in production accounts.
The skill does not deploy infrastructure by itself.
Third-party API examples are Stripe-focused and need provider-specific changes.
Secret retrieval examples can expose credentials if copied without safeguards.

use_cases.title: Configure RDS Rotation
use_cases.description: Set up Secrets Manager rotation for database credentials with Lambda and rotation schedules.

use_cases.title: Rotate API Keys
use_cases.description: Design a provider-specific API key rotation flow with validation and old key retirement.

use_cases.title: Audit Rotation Coverage
use_cases.description: Review secret inventory, rotation status, overdue secrets, and compliance gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Start RDS Rotation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for managed database credentials.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up AWS Secrets Manager rotation for an RDS MySQL database. Explain required inputs and safe testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build Rotation Lambda
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation for a custom rotation workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a rotation Lambda plan for a custom service credential. Include create, set, test, and finish stages.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Secret Compliance
prompt_templates.scenario: Operational review across an AWS account.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rotation compliance audit plan for my AWS secrets. Include overdue checks, monitoring, and reporting fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Emergency Rotation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced response after suspected credential compromise.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an emergency rotation runbook for compromised database and API credentials. Include rollback, validation, and communication steps.

output_examples.input: Set up automatic rotation for production database credentials.
output: Rotation plan with required secret fields, Lambda permissions, and schedule.
Testing checklist for a non-production database before rollout.
Monitoring recommendations for rotation failures and delayed rotation.

output_examples.input: Audit all secrets for rotation compliance.
output: Inventory summary with rotation enabled status and last rotation date.
List of secrets without rotation or with overdue rotation.
Recommended follow-up actions for owners and alerting gaps.

output_examples.input: Create an emergency rotation plan for a leaked API key.
output: Immediate containment steps for new key creation and service validation.
Safe old key revocation sequence with rollback considerations.
Post-incident evidence and monitoring items to collect.

best_practices: Test every rotation workflow in a non-production account before enabling production schedules.
Use least-privilege IAM permissions for rotation Lambdas and audit scripts.
Avoid printing secret values to terminals, logs, shell history, or shared reports.
anti_patterns: Do not paste live credentials into examples, prompts, or command history.
Do not revoke old API keys before new credentials are validated by dependent services.
Do not store private key files locally without strict permissions and cleanup steps.

faq.question: Does this skill rotate secrets automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. You must deploy and test the AWS resources in your environment.

faq.question: Which AWS services are covered?
faq.answer: The guide covers Secrets Manager, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, and related AWS CLI workflows.

faq.question: Can it handle third-party API keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Stripe-style pattern that must be adapted to each provider API.

faq.question: Is it safe to copy the secret retrieval examples?
faq.answer: Use caution. Some examples print or write secrets, so add secure handling before production use.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does the skill include compliance reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a rotation audit approach and a compliance report pattern for overdue secrets.
